about: The editing keys with three Audio cues selected (2.1, 2.2, 2.3: do-not-continue / auto-follow / do-not-continue, unflagged / flagged / unflagged, pre-waits 0 / 1.5 / 3). C gives all three auto-continue, F flags all three, E puts the caret in the inspector's one pre-wait field (Mixed) and 7 + Return gives all three 7 s, D does nothing, O puts the caret in the inspector's notes.
